item.title: Zomba Arts Platform selected for regional digital heritage programme
item.description: Zomba Arts Platform (ZAP) has been chosen as Malawi’s implementing partner for Futures_Past: Amplifying Memory with Immersive Technologies, a regional initiative exploring new approaches to engaging with heritage through digital tools. The programme brings together cultural and archival institutions across Southern Africa to rethink how archival materials can be accessed, interpreted, and experienced. item.title: Wav Gardn’s Umdeni blends Afrocentric neo-soul with spiritual depth
item.description: Afrocentric neo-soul continues to gain momentum within Johannesburg’s alternative music scene, and Wav Gardn are among the emerging acts contributing to this shift. Their four-track EP, Umdeni, presents a concise body of work rooted in themes of African spirituality, resilience and renewal. The project opens with ‘Ithuba’, structured as a reflective appeal for guidance and opportunity. item.title: Open call: 2026 ACT Nyoloha Scholarship Programme
item.description: The Arts & Culture Trust (ACT) has opened applications for the 2026 Nyoloha Scholarship Programme, marking the fifth edition of the national initiative aimed at supporting emerging artists through funded tertiary study and professional development. The scholarship covers tuition and prescribed study materials only and supports studies in performing, visual and digital arts. item.title: Tyla to release second studio album A-Pop in March
item.description: South African singer Tyla will release her second studio album, A-Pop, on 15 March 2026, marking her first full-length project since winning the Grammy Award for Best African Music Performance. The forthcoming album arrives at a time of heightened international attention for the artist, who has become one of the most prominent African pop figures on the global stage. item.title: Behind the mic: Why radio producers are the quiet architects of connection
item.description: By Mzi Kaka Most listeners only hear the final product: the music, the banter, the seamless flow of conversation. What they do not hear is the architecture behind it. The radio producer is the invisible hand shaping the show long before the “On Air” light flickers to life. item.title: TikTok reportedly revising music royalty model to include per-play payments
item.description: TikTok is preparing to revise the way it pays music rights holders, according to information shared with Digital Music News (DMN), in a move that could significantly alter how royalties are calculated on the platform. Under TikTok’s existing system, rights holders are typically paid only for the initial use of a track in a video, regardless of how many times that video is viewed. item.title: LIV Golf South Africa fest to combine music, sport in Jorburg
item.description: Johannesburg will host the LIV Golf South Africa festival from 19 to 22 March 2026, a four-day event combining live music, golf and lifestyle experiences at Steyn City. The festival will feature performances by Scottish DJ and producer Calvin Harris, alongside South African artists Black Coffee and GoldFish. item.title: Spotify explores AI music interaction amid licensing challenges
item.description: Spotify has signalled its intention to allow listeners to interact with their favourite artists’ music using artificial intelligence, though licensing issues remain a key barrier. The comments were made by co-CEO Gustav Söderström during the company’s Q4 2025 earnings call on 10 February. Söderström outlined two categories for AI music on the platform. item.title: Boyz II Men announce SA tour dates for May 2026
item.description: South African fans of R&B are set to welcome the return of Boyz II Men, one of the world’s most acclaimed vocal groups, with a live tour scheduled for May. The Grammy-winning trio will perform on 27 May at the Grand Arena, GrandWest in Cape Town, followed by shows on 29 and 30 May at the SunBet Arena, Time Square, Pretoria. The concerts are expected to feature a selection of the group’s most iconic hits, including ‘End of the Road’, ‘I’ll Make Love to You’, ‘On Bended Knee’, and ‘Motownphilly’.

item.title: Open call: Global Music Awards 2026
item.description: The Global Music Awards has opened its annual entry period, inviting musicians from across the world to submit work for consideration in multiple categories. The competition, established in 2011 by Thomas Eugene Baker, is an international music event that focuses on recognising independent artists based on the merits of their music rather than commercial success or fan base size.
